parsed.attack: This is the daily spoken check-in, and the arithmetic is the one that does not bend. Three minutes every weekday is 66 minutes per active per month: $0.33-1.19 on the $0.005-$0.018 cheap stacks, and $6.01 at the $0.091 flagship rate that a call whose whole point is reading your dodged commitments back to you will actually need. Their own kill line 3 prices the product at 3% conversion, and at 3% every payer carries 33 actives: $11-39 per payer per month on the cheapest stack available and $198 at flagship, against a $8-24 median payer. There is no trial-free version either - nobody buys a talking accountability service without taking calls first - and even a generous 20% trial-to-pay leaves five actives per payer, which is $6 of voice cheap and $30 flagship per payer per month.
parsed.strongest_defence: Price against the substitute rather than the app store: this audience already pays a human $100-500/month for check-ins, so charge $49/month ($41 net), cap the trial at two calls, run the cheap stack, and $6 of voice against $41 clears comfortably with a $20-80 CAC repaying in month one.
parsed.verdict_reason: At the author's own 3% conversion, 66 voice-minutes per active across 33 actives per payer is $11-198 of inference per payer per month against $8-24 of revenue, so even the cheapest stack is underwater and only abandoning both the price band and the conversion assumption escapes it.
